units.source_text: “那些樟树，不知现在怎么样了？”

en.t: I wonder what has become of those camphor trees now?

units.source_text: 他有时会在织机声中念叨。

en.t: Sometimes he would murmur this amid the sound of the loom.

units.source_text: 不至于被占领军伐倒吧。

en.t: Surely they would not have been cut down by the occupation forces.
